# AE Property Management & Consult

> Boutique property management, oversight and concierge services for prestige villas and estates in Mallorca (Balearic Islands, Spain). AE intentionally limits the number of properties it cares for to offer a direct, discreet and highly personal service, whether the owner is on the island or abroad. Founded and led by Andrea.

- Area: mainly the south, south-east and south-west of Mallorca; other areas assessed individually.
- Languages: Spanish, English and German.
- Pricing: personalised monthly plans from €250 per month, depending on the property, location, facilities, visit frequency and needs.
- Guarantee: if expectations are not met after the first three months, one month's fee is refunded under the agreed terms.
- Contact: info@aeproperties.es · +34 601 927 601 (phone and WhatsApp)

## Services

- [Property management and oversight](https://aeproperties.es/en/servicios.html): regular visits and condition reports, home preparation before arrival, incidents, keys, access and deliveries, coordination of cleaning, gardens, pools, repairs and installation maintenance. Technical work is done by specialised professionals selected and overseen by AE.
- [Concierge and personalised assistance](https://aeproperties.es/en/servicios.html): pre-arrival shopping, private chef, laundry and upholstery cleaning, parcels, transfers and bookings, private events, pet and vehicle care.
- [Renovation management and supervision](https://aeproperties.es/en/servicios.html): review of proposals and budgets, coordination of architects and contractors, site visits, photo reports, budget and payment control. AE coordinates and follows up; it is not a building contractor or architecture firm.
- [Real estate](https://aeproperties.es/en/servicios.html): discreet, selected transactions for owners, buyers and investors through a private client portfolio and partner network.
